content.short: Kizzy is a mobile app for over-under bets on YouTube and X creator metrics.
content.description: Kizzy runs over-under markets on creator statistics such as views and follower counts, settled from public platform data. Attention metrics are an unusual underlying, and their reliability rests entirely on the platform's own numbers being accurate and not retroactively adjusted.
content.meta: Over-under markets on creator statistics, settled from public platform data.
